limitations: Does not recover forced runner termination or machine/process crashes.
Does not terminate or contain child-created descendants; not process-tree isolation or a sandbox.
Usage reporting remains cooperative and does not impose provider-side spend limits.
This fixture does not establish cross-platform correctness or independent review.
